profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Surgical Information Systems
profile.summary: I am searching for an entry-level Software Engineering position. I have an intermediate knowledge of Java, C#, SQL, and several months of first-hand exposure to the Agile Scrum development methodology. I am a strong team member, and I demonstrate exceptional creativity, excellent people skills, and a positive work ethic.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Acquire daily exposure to the Agile Scrum development process, including sitting in on daily stand-ups, retros, and sizing meetings
•	Actively participate in testing and debugging of web applications in Angular/Typescript and C#/.Net
•	Assist in building installation solutions using C# and WiX Toolset 
•	Investigate and assist in resolving support tickets

positions.title: Lot Associate
positions.description:
•	Assisted customers with the loading of their vehicles
•	Monitored and maintained a clean and welcoming appearance for the store

positions.title: Crew Trainer / Biscuit Maker
positions.description:
•	Responsible for training peers and new team members on various workstations
•	Assist in the certification and retraining of existing employees 
•	Ensure standards are observed by all co-workers

positions.title: Master Merchandiser
positions.description:
•	Communicated effectively with store managers and employees
•	Coordinated and assisted in projects with peer merchandisers

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
•	Provided friendly customer service when greeting and taking guests’ orders
•	Resolved issues and complaints from guests promptly and satisfactorily
•	Invited by superiors to attend managerial training
